feature: The two-line card row (foil addendum R3), the glint under the dot, and the Shopping key
note: PR 2 of the foil mark (plan `2026-10-15-foil-mark.md`). The card row is two lines from md in All and from lg in Shopping, and option B below md in Shopping (Hugh made B the row for everyone, 2026-10-15; the phone All row and Shopping from md to lg are the shipped rows). Photographed at 390, 900 and 1300, because 900 is the one width where All is two-line and Shopping is not.\n\nPRECONDITION: the sheet account must own a foil card in the deck (`FOIL_CARD`, set to every-copy-foil on a scratch branch) or no glint is drawn and the sheet reads as coverage; The deck must hold a card priced over its limit: the Shopping cell scrolls to a row carrying the stand-ins press, so it fails when none exists. A scratch branch of local-dev is the right database (set the finish on the scratch copy only). The first cell of a run lands on the Welcome page (the About gate marks itself seen on that visit); the first row's two throwaway visits absorb it.

shares.note: The row draws the glint as-is; the key draws FoilMark (foil-mark-key.json).

rows.label: /decks/[id] All: the two-line row (name, marks and ✕ on line 1; the glint under the dot, pips, marker and tag on line 2)
/decks/[id] All, List view on the phone: the shipped row (name over pips), the glint at the head of its meta line, under the dot, pips at the name's x
/decks/[id] Shopping: an over-limit row (two lines from lg, B below md, the shipped column from md to lg), no EDHREC figure
/decks/[id] Shopping: a foil card that is short (so Shopping lists it), the glint under the dot with the pips at the name's x (option B at 390, the shipped column at 900, two lines from lg)
